description: This file implements logging functionalities for Trusty within the Android project, including message splitting, severity-based logging, and log message management.

classes.name: LogMessageData
classes.description: Holds data for a log message, including file, line, severity, tag, and error information.

classes.name: LogMessage
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of a log message, including formatting and output.

methods.name: GetFileBasename
methods.description: Extracts the basename from a file path.

methods.name: SplitByLines
methods.description: Splits a message into lines and logs each line separately.

methods.name: DefaultAborter
methods.description: Logs an abort message and terminates the program.

methods.name: TrustyLogLine
methods.description: Logs a single line with a given severity and tag.

methods.name: TrustyLogger
methods.description: Splits a full message into lines and logs each line with specified severity and tag.

methods.name: LogMessage
methods.description: Constructs a log message object, manages its destruction, and outputs the message.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides access to the internal buffer for streaming log message content.

methods.name: LogLine
methods.description: Logs a message line with file, line number, severity, and tag.

methods.name: ShouldLog
methods.description: Determines if a message with given severity and tag should be logged.
